description: Full-text search over the Spicrawl documentation (guides, API reference, errors, limits). Use it to look up a parameter name, value or combination for a spicrawl_* tool, or to explain an error a spicrawl_* tool returned: search the error code itself (e.g. `ERR::UPSTREAM::CHALLENGE`) and the result also carries a direct link to that code's entry on the errors page. Returns the best-matching pages, each with its title, the matching sections (heading, a short snippet, URL) and md_url; then call spicrawl_docs_read with a page's md_url or url to read it in full.

query.description: What to look for: a feature, parameter, error code or question, e.g. 'wait_for selector' or 'ERR::AUTH::INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE'.

name: spicrawl_docs_search

error_code.description: Present when the query is an error code (ERR::AREA::NAME).

md_url.description: The errors page as Markdown; read it with spicrawl_docs_read.

url.description: The code's entry on the errors page.

hint.description: What to try when there are no results.

results.description: Matching pages, most relevant first. Empty when nothing matched.

heading.description: The section the match is in.

snippet.description: A short plain-text excerpt around the match.

url.description: Link to the section, with its #anchor.

md_url.description: The page as Markdown; pass it to spicrawl_docs_read.

url.description: The page on the docs site.

title: Search the Spicrawl docs
